heading.en: Factory-Made Membranes and Why Thickness Matters
heading.zh: 工厂预制防水卷材及厚度的重要性

body.en: Factory-made sheet goods such as SBS waterproof membrane rolls, PVC waterproof membrane sheets, and TPO membrane roof liners arrive at consistent gauges that site-applied coatings rarely match. For a waterproof membrane supplier Africa buyers rely on, thickness directly governs puncture resistance, weld integrity, and service life under intense solar radiation and heavy rain. A typical industry value for torch on SBS rolls is 3 mm to 4 mm per layer, while single-ply PVC and TPO sheets commonly range from 1.2 mm to 2.0 mm, with 1.5 mm as a typical industry value for commercial roofs. Relevant reference standards include EN 13707 for reinforced bitumen sheets, EN 13956 for plastic and rubber roof sheets, ASTM D4637 for TPO, and ISO 9001 for quality management. During torch on membrane installation, first sweep dust and remove standing water from the substrate, then apply primer and allow full drying. Next, unroll the sheet to check alignment and overlap width, typically 80 mm to 100 mm on side laps as a typical industry value. Heat the underside evenly with a propane torch until the bitumen glosses, press the roll forward to squeeze out a small bead, and seal seams with a rounded roller. For shipments routed through Beira or Durban toward Zimbabwe and inland sites, palletized rolls wrapped in stretch film and corner boards help prevent edge crushing during port handling and long-haul road transit.
body.zh: 工厂预制卷材如SBS防水卷材、PVC防水卷材和TPO屋面防水卷材具有均匀厚度，现场涂刷涂层很少能达到这种一致性。对于非洲买家信赖的防水卷材供应商而言，厚度直接影响抗穿刺性能、焊缝完整性以及在强烈日照和暴雨下的使用寿命。热熔SBS卷材每层厚度通常为3毫米至4毫米，属于典型行业数值；单层PVC和TPO卷材常见厚度为1.2毫米至2.0毫米，其中商用屋面以1.5毫米为典型行业数值。相关参考标准包括增强沥青卷材EN 13707、塑料和橡胶屋面卷材EN 13956、TPO标准ASTM D4637以及质量管理标准ISO 9001。热熔卷材施工时，先清扫基层灰尘并排净积水，再涂刷底涂并充分干燥。随后展开卷材检查对准与搭接宽度，搭接边通常为80毫米至100毫米，属于典型行业数值。用丙烷喷枪均匀加热卷材底面至沥青泛亮，向前滚压挤出少量溢胶，并用圆角压辊封边。对于经贝拉或德班发往津巴布韦及内陆工地的货物，采用缠绕膜和护角加固的托盘卷材有助于防止港口装卸和长途公路运输中的边缘压损。

heading.en: SBS Modified Bitumen: Torch-On and Self-Adhesive
heading.zh: SBS改性沥青：热熔型与自粘型

body.en: An SBS waterproof membrane blends asphalt with styrene-butadiene-styrene rubber for cold-weather flexibility and elongation. Common roll sizes are 1 m wide by 10 m long, with a waterproof membrane thickness of 3 mm or 4 mm, while 2 mm is a typical industry value for self-adhesive variants. Standards such as EN 13707 for roof waterproofing, ASTM D6164 for polyester-reinforced SBS sheets, and ISO 9001 quality management guide material selection and consistency. Torch on membrane installation uses a propane torch to melt the underside bitumen while unrolling onto a primed concrete or screed substrate, pressing seams with a rounded trowel until a 5 mm to 10 mm bitumen bead appears. Torch-on suits flat roofs, podium decks, and foundations where open flame is permitted, whereas self-adhesive rolls use a release liner and pressure-sensitive compound for flame-free work near combustible insulation or occupied spaces. Compared with a PVC waterproof membrane or TPO membrane roof, SBS sheets handle rough substrates and heavy foot traffic well, though exposed rolls typically need protective gravel, pavers, or a mineral cap sheet. For shipments to Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa, Mozambique, Tanzania, and Kenya routed through Beira, Durban, and Mombasa, pallets wrapped in stretch film and edge protectors help resist coastal humidity and port handling during container transit.
body.zh: SBS防水卷材将沥青与苯乙烯-丁二烯-苯乙烯橡胶共混，具备低温柔韧性和延伸率。常见卷材规格为宽1米、长10米，防水卷材厚度通常为3毫米或4毫米，而2毫米是自粘型产品的典型行业值。屋面防水的EN 13707、聚酯胎SBS卷材的ASTM D6164以及ISO 9001质量管理等标准可指导选材与稳定性。热熔卷材施工使用丙烷喷灯熔化卷材底面沥青，同时在已涂底漆的混凝土或找平层基面上铺展，并用圆角抹子压实接缝，直至挤出5毫米至10毫米宽的沥青溢胶。热熔型适用于允许明火的平屋面、裙楼平台和基础工程，而自粘卷材采用离型膜和压敏胶层，可在靠近可燃保温层或有人区域进行无明火施工。与PVC防水卷材或TPO屋面卷材相比，SBS卷材能较好适应粗糙基面和较重行人踩踏，但外露铺设通常需要砾石、铺地砖或矿物颗粒覆面层进行保护。发往津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非、莫桑比克、坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚，并经由贝拉、德班和蒙巴萨中转的货物，采用缠绕膜和护角加固的托盘有助于在集装箱运输中抵御沿海潮气与港口装卸搬运。

body.en: Single-ply PVC waterproof membrane and TPO membrane roof sheets offer heat-welded seams for flat and low-slope roofs without open-flame torch on membrane installation. A typical industry value for membrane thickness ranges from 1.2 mm to 2.0 mm, with roll widths commonly around 1.5 m or 2.0 m and roll lengths of 20 m. Buyers evaluating a waterproof membrane supplier Africa wide should check compliance with EN 13956, ASTM D4434 for PVC, and ASTM D6878 for TPO, alongside UV resistance under intense solar exposure across southern and eastern Africa. When selecting between PVC and TPO, verify chemical compatibility with oils, exhausts, or plasticizer migration near mechanical vents and drainage outlets. For step-by-step installation, first inspect and clean the substrate to remove dust, standing water, and sharp debris, then lay out loose rolls with 50 mm to 100 mm side and end laps. Second, mechanically fasten or adhere the sheets per wind-uplift design requirements, keeping fasteners outside seam overlap zones. Third, weld overlapping seams with a hot-air automatic welder at calibrated temperature and speed, then probe every seam using a rounded seam probe to confirm a continuous bond without cold welds or burn-through. Finally, detail flashings, corners, and roof drains before container dispatch through Durban or Beira in moisture-protected pallets or wrapped rolls, alongside any SBS waterproof membrane consignments for regional construction projects.
body.zh: 单层PVC防水卷材和TPO防水卷材屋面片材为平屋面和低坡屋面提供热风焊接缝，无需使用明火热熔施工。防水卷材厚度的典型行业数值通常在1.2毫米至2.0毫米之间，卷材宽度常见约为1.5米或2.0米，卷长为20米。评估非洲防水卷材供应商时，应核查是否符合EN 13956、PVC适用的ASTM D4434以及TPO适用的ASTM D6878，同时关注南部非洲和东部非洲高强度日照下的抗紫外线性能。在选择PVC与TPO时，需核实其与油脂、排烟或增塑剂迁移的化学相容性，尤其在机械通风口和排水口附近。按步骤施工时，首先检查并清理基层以清除粉尘、积水和尖锐杂物，随后铺设卷材并留出50毫米至100毫米的搭接边与端头搭接。其次，按抗风揭设计要求进行机械固定或粘结，使紧固件避开搭接焊缝区域。第三，使用自动热风焊机在标定温度和速度下焊接搭接缝，并用圆头焊缝探针检测每条焊缝，确认形成无虚焊或烧穿的连续焊缝。最后，在通过德班或贝拉集装箱发运前，完成泛水、阴阳角和屋面落水口细部处理，并采用防潮托盘或缠绕卷材包装，以配合区域建筑项目的防水卷材订单发运。

heading.zh: 厚度选择：3毫米、4毫米与5毫米

body.en: Choosing the right waterproof membrane thickness requires matching sheet gauge to structural movement, exposure and torch on membrane installation method. For an SBS waterproof membrane or TPO membrane roof, thickness directly affects puncture resistance, weld integrity and service life. A 3 mm waterproof membrane is typically used on light-duty roofs, pitched decks or secondary flashing where roof traffic is rare and substrate movement is low. A 4 mm sheet suits general flat roofs, balconies and terraces with moderate foot traffic, acting as a common benchmark for a waterproof membrane supplier Africa buyers rely on. A 5 mm sheet is selected for heavy-duty podiums, planted gardens, parking decks or high-exposure commercial roofs where root growth, gravel ballast or intense ultraviolet and thermal cycling occur. Relevant standards such as EN 13707 for reinforced bitumen sheets, EN 13956 for plastic and rubber sheets, ASTM D6164 for SBS-modified bitumen and ISO 1183 for density govern material evaluation, while typical industry values for SBS elongation or tensile strength help compare grades. First, inspect concrete or screed decks for moisture, laitance and cracks. Second, confirm drainage slope and detail corners with reinforcement strips before unrolling. Third, dry-fit overlaps, typically 80 to 100 mm on side seams and 150 mm on end laps, and heat-weld or torch apply evenly until a uniform melt bead appears. On shipments routed through Durban or Beira to Zimbabwe, verify pallet strapping and moisture wraps to prevent edge crushing during container transit.
body.zh: 选择合适的防水卷材厚度需要将片材规格与结构变形、环境暴露及热熔卷材施工方法相匹配。对于SBS防水卷材或TPO屋面卷材，厚度直接影响抗穿刺性能、焊缝完整性和使用寿命。3毫米防水卷材通常用于轻型屋面、坡屋顶或次要泛水部位，这类区域屋面通行较少且基层变形较小。4毫米片材适用于普通平屋面、阳台和露台等具有中等步行荷载的场景，也是非洲防水卷材供应商常供的通用基准规格。5毫米片材则用于重型裙楼、种植屋面、停车甲板或高暴露商业屋面，这些部位存在植物根系生长、砂石压载或强烈的紫外线与热循环作用。EN 13707增强沥青卷材、EN 13956塑料和橡胶卷材、ASTM D6164 SBS改性沥青卷材以及ISO 1183密度等标准规范了材料评估，而SBS伸长率或拉伸强度等典型行业数值有助于对比不同等级。施工时，第一步应检查混凝土或找平层基面的含水率、浮浆和裂缝。第二步，在展卷前确认排水坡度，并用加强条处理阴阳角。第三步，干铺搭接边（侧搭接通常为80至100毫米，端搭接为150毫米），随后进行热风焊接或均匀烘烤热熔，直至形成连续均匀的溢胶条。对于经德班或贝拉运往津巴布韦的货物，应核查托盘捆扎与防潮包装，防止集装箱运输途中边缘受压变形。

body.en: Proper lap geometry and a controlled installation sequence prevent seam leaks across SBS waterproof membrane, PVC waterproof membrane, and TPO membrane roof systems. For torch on membrane installation using SBS sheets, typical industry values are 75 mm to 100 mm side laps and 100 mm to 150 mm end laps, with T-joints staggered and rounded or sealed to eliminate capillary paths. For single-ply TPO and PVC membranes, hot-air welded laps typically use a 38 mm to 50 mm minimum fused weld width within wider sheet overlaps, tested against EN 12316-2 or ASTM D751 peel and shear practices where specified. Follow this sequence on site. First, inspect and clean the substrate so it is dry, dust-free, and free of sharp ridges, applying primer ahead of bituminous torch work per EN 13707 or ASTM D6164 guidelines. Second, unroll sheets from low points toward high points and let thermoplastic rolls relax before fastening or bonding so shrinkage does not stress seams. Third, align side and end laps cleanly, protecting exposed lap zones from dust or moisture. Fourth, flame-torch SBS backing film with a smooth bitumen bead squeeze-out or hot-air weld TPO and PVC seams using calibrated temperature and speed, rolling immediately with a silicone or metal roller. Fifth, detail penetrations, drains, and terminations, then probe every seam with a dull hook after cooling. Shipments routed through Beira or Durban for projects in Zimbabwe benefit from moisture-tight pallet wrapping and impact protection for rolls and fasteners.
body.zh: 合理搭接尺寸与受控施工顺序可防止SBS防水卷材、PVC防水卷材及TPO屋面卷材接缝渗漏。SBS热熔施工时，典型行业数值为长边搭接75至100毫米、短边搭接100至150毫米，T型接头错开并圆角或密封以防毛细渗水。单层TPO和PVC热风焊接搭接在更宽重叠区内通常采用至少38至50毫米熔合焊缝宽度，按规定参照EN 12316-2或ASTM D751剥离与剪切方法检测。现场步骤如下：一、清理并检查基层至干燥、无尘、无尖锐棱角，依据EN 13707或ASTM D6164指南在沥青热熔前涂刷底涂；二、从低处向高处展卷，固定或粘结前让热塑性卷材松弛以防收缩拉扯接缝；三、对齐长短边搭接，保护外露搭接区免受灰尘或潮气污染；四、火焰烘烤SBS底膜挤出平顺沥青边，或按校准温速热风焊接TPO与PVC接缝，立即用硅胶辊或金属辊碾压；五、处理穿孔件、地漏和收口，冷却后用钝钩探查接缝。经贝拉或德班发往津巴布韦的货物应采用防潮托盘缠绕并做好卷材与紧固件抗冲击防护。

heading.zh: 地下室防渗与屋顶外露对比

body.en: Selecting the right waterproof membrane depends on whether the structure faces hydrostatic groundwater pressure in a basement or direct ultraviolet radiation, thermal cycling, and standing rain on an exposed roof. For basement tanking, installers often apply a polymer-modified bitumen sheet such as an SBS waterproof membrane with a typical industry value of 3 mm to 4 mm thickness, installed by torch on membrane installation onto a primed concrete substrate. Standards such as EN 13969 for damp proofing and water vapour control or ASTM D6164 for styrene-butadiene-styrene bituminous sheets help buyers verify tensile strength, cold flexibility, and water tightness. Before applying the waterproof membrane to a basement wall or slab, prime the clean, sound concrete, seal corners and pipe penetrations with detailing strips, heat the underside with a propane torch to melt the bitumen, roll the sheet firmly to eliminate air pockets, and protect the finished layer with drainage board or screed prior to backfilling. By contrast, an exposed flat roof experiences intense solar UV and wide day-night temperature swings, making a single-ply PVC waterproof membrane or TPO membrane roof typically 1.2 mm to 2.0 mm thick (typical industry value) more suitable than unshielded bitumen. Roof membranes follow standards such as EN 13956 or ASTM D4434 for PVC and ASTM D6878 for TPO, with hot-air welded seams. For shipments moving through Durban or Beira into southern Africa, palletized rolls and moisture-resistant wrapping help prevent edge crushing and transit dampness.
body.zh: 选择哪种防水膜，取决于结构面临的是地下室静水压力，还是外露屋顶的紫外线辐射、热循环与积水。用于地下室防水抗渗时，施工方常采用聚合物改性沥青卷材，如厚度为3毫米至4毫米的SBS防水膜（典型行业值），通过热熔法施工铺贴在已涂刷底漆的混凝土基层上。EN 13969防潮与水汽控制标准或ASTM D6164苯乙烯-丁二烯-苯乙烯沥青卷材标准有助于买家核实拉伸强度、低温柔性与水密性。在地下室墙体或底板铺贴防水膜前，先清理并确认混凝土基层坚固，用加强条密封阴阳角与穿管节点，用丙烷喷灯加热卷材底面熔化沥青，滚压卷材排出空气，并在回填前用排水板或砂浆保护层保护成品。相比之下，外露平屋顶承受强烈太阳紫外线和较大的昼夜温差，单层PVC防水膜或TPO屋顶膜通常厚1.2毫米至2.0毫米（典型行业值），比无防护沥青更合适。屋顶膜遵循PVC适用的EN 13956或ASTM D4434以及TPO适用的ASTM D6878等标准，接缝采用热风焊接。对于经德班或贝拉运往南部非洲的货物，托盘码放卷材与防潮包装有助于防止边角受压变形和运输受潮。

body.en: Waterproof membrane rolls for SBS waterproof membrane, PVC waterproof membrane, and TPO membrane roof systems require sturdy packaging for sea transit to Africa, including Zimbabwe via Beira or Durban. A typical industry value for standard rolls is 1.0 m width by 10.0 m to 20.0 m length, with waterproof membrane thickness commonly from 1.2 mm to 4.0 mm and typical roll weights around 35 kg to 55 kg. Each roll is wrapped in PE film or release film to prevent sticking, fitted with cardboard end protectors, and stacked upright or horizontally on heat-treated wooden pallets under ISPM 15. For container loading, inspect the 20 ft or 40 ft HC container for dryness, odor, and intact seals, place moisture-absorbing desiccant bags inside, block and brace pallets so rolls cannot shift during rough swells, and record roll batch numbers, thickness, and gross weight on the packing list. During torch on membrane installation or single-ply detailing, verify roll labels match specified thickness and project drawings before unrolling. For a waterproof membrane supplier Africa buyers rely on, clear marking supports customs clearance and warehouse handling. Follow general handling and transport guidance aligned with ISO 780 package marking, ASTM D4169 performance testing for shipping containers and systems, and EN 1848-1 determination of length, width, straightness and flatness for bituminous sheets. Proper palletization also reduces forklift edge dents when unloading at port depots and job sites.
body.zh: 用于SBS防水卷材、PVC防水卷材和TPO屋面卷材系统的防水卷材卷材在海运至非洲，包括经贝拉或德班前往津巴布韦时，需要坚固包装。标准卷材的典型行业值为宽1.0米、长10.0米至20.0米，防水卷材厚度常见为1.2毫米至4.0毫米，典型卷重约35公斤至55公斤。每卷用PE膜或隔离膜包裹以防粘连，配纸板端护角，并按ISPM 15标准直立或水平码放在热处理木托盘上。装箱时，检查20英尺或40英尺高柜是否干燥、无异味且箱封完好，放入吸湿干燥剂袋，对托盘挡撑加固防止卷材在风浪中移位，并在装箱单记录批号、厚度和毛重。热熔防水卷材施工或单层细部处理时，展开前核对卷材标签是否与规定厚度及图纸一致。对非洲买家信赖的防水卷材供应商而言，清晰标识有助于清关和库房搬运。遵循符合ISO 780包装标记、ASTM D4169运输集装箱及系统性能测试以及EN 1848-1沥青卷材长宽平直度测定标准的搬运运输指导，规范码放也能减少港口堆场和工地卸货时叉车造成的边缘凹陷。
